name: SiliconFlow free models
amount: Some models free to use, with rate limits; only after real-name identity verification
summary: Chinese inference platform with a set of permanently free models (small Qwen and similar). Since 15 May 2026, accounts without real-name verification can't use the platform at all. Verification is built around mainland-Chinese identity documents; international users are reported to need to contact support. Many free-API lists still present it as simply free.
source_note: SiliconFlow release notes (real-name requirement from 15 May 2026), checked 2026-09-28. Not tracked per model: we can't verify an account.

changes.text: SiliconFlow now requires real-name identity verification before any platform use, including its free models.
